what: The FM-1 as a generative nature machine: wind, sea, rain, fire, birds, crickets and thunder, mixing by themselves. White keys pick 11 places and switch layers, black keys play events (press harder: stronger), a full-screen pixel-art scene follows the sound.
author: Gorgonzola777
sounds: CC0: VSCO-2 Community Edition and VCSL by Versilian Studios (Felucca's sample pack, assets/samples-cc0); NATURE's own sounds are synthesised
